title: Records Welch heard and Bessie Smith
summary: Welch lists blues records he heard (Papa Charlie Jackson, Blind Lemon, Lonnie Johnson, Ma Rainey) and names Bessie Smith as favorite, claiming to have seen her sing in Mississippi.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Bessie, Mamie, Ma Rainey: the classic blues queens
